scope: Independent bounded static review and hash/byte readback only; no product tests, browser, server, network or upload execution; no repository edits.

prior_review.archival_limit: The initial helper body was read but was not archived before the owner repair. The initial receipt explicitly records snapshot_saved=false for that helper. This review archives the actual repaired helper and the other three current source files; it does not reconstruct or claim an initial helper snapshot.

closed_finding.basis: DOM read and file-save chain each have a 250 ms Promise.race observer wait bound. DOM rejection or timeout yields an explicit state marker. File rejection or timeout emits a static incomplete message, aborts the write signal and returns to the caller, which rethrows the same caught error. The reviewer did not execute the owner-reported boundary cases.

original_test_binding.checked: Removing only the observer import, TestInfo parameter and try/catch/finally observation wrapper makes the entire current reader.spec.ts byte-identical to the immutable baseline. The original page.goto, expectation text, remaining historical/hash-conflict assertions and their timeouts are unchanged.

checks: Observation is installed before the original first page.goto and disposed in finally on success or failure. Event callbacks read only GET path/revision/status/completion/failure; no route interception, additional application requests, headers, cookies, request or response bodies, fragment reads or application state mutation.

One Node monotonic clock timestamps observed request notifications and capture start. Events are capped at 2000 and omissions counted. DOM state is explicitly post-failure, not an assertion-time snapshot or causal proof.

A complete JSON string is written to an excluded .pending path before rename to the exact whitelisted artifact filename; incomplete writes do not intentionally publish truncated JSON. The original error is rethrown after observation handling.

Workflow retains make test-e2e without continue-on-error. The artifact step requires both failure() and native.outcome=failure; only the three exact filename families within the dedicated runner-temp output are allowed. Three-day retention, missing-file warning, hidden-file exclusion and trace off remain explicit.
The Playwright change only permits the output-directory override and failure-only screenshots. Test timeout, workers, headless mode, viewport, web servers and trace off remain unchanged.

The upload action uses a fixed commit. Official tag/action correspondence and owner structural checks are owner-supplied evidence; this reviewer did not repeat network verification or configuration execution.
limitations: The two 250 ms limits bound awaiting by scheduled timers, not a hard real-time wall-clock guarantee under a blocked Node event loop or an already exhausted overall test budget.

Promise.race does not cancel page.evaluate. writeFile uses an AbortSignal, but a rename already underway can complete after the save wait timed out. Such a late final file still derives from a completed write; the incomplete console message truthfully records the observer wait limit, not guaranteed I/O cancellation.
No claim of zero observer timing overhead or original CI root cause. DOM can change before post-failure observation.

Actual CI artifact production/download and the original historical Reader CI failure remain unverified by this static review. Synthetic deliberately blocked-request checks, if performed by the owner, are diagnostic-path validation rather than reproduction of the original CI cause.
